decision_stability_gate.ratio: E_ALT1 + E_CONTROL0 divided by Delta_candidate; common-provider equivalent E/Delta_candidate

future_model_priority: compact residual MLP only if simple methods fail
missing_data_policy: formal unavailable != zero importance; encode MDC_IMPORTANCE=UNKNOWN; no interpolation, extrapolation, symmetry fill, nearest-neighbor fill, or uniform fill
model_or_calibration_target: RCWA angular baseline + sparse FDTD calibration
numeric_promotion_threshold: not frozen beyond the preregistered 0.5 decision-stability gate; no post-hoc threshold changes
polarization_policy: P/S explicit; no P/S averaging or substitution
source_scope: EXPLORATORY_ONLY; Level-1 provider evidence, not Level-2 integrated truth
u_x_policy: exact signed package identity only; no +/-u_x substitution
